sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: Neutralizes AppsFlyer attribution/telemetry: the SDK is never initialized or started, and the JS bridge reports success as usual.
Stops CleverTap session/activity tracking and push-click attribution. Push notifications themselves keep working.
Makes Firebase Performance's connection wrapper a pass-through (no perf telemetry) and reports installs as Play-installed regardless of the actual installer.
Stops MyDialog from exiting itself on root/debug/emulator/adb detection and on Play Integrity failure. Signature verification is reported clean so patched builds pass.

Removes certificate pinning at both layers (OkHttp pin comparison and the platform network-security-config pin-set) and trusts user-installed CAs, so HTTPS traffic can be inspected with a MITM proxy. Normal TLS validation stays intact.
Disables Google Analytics measurement and Facebook SDK auto-init, and turns off Firebase Analytics/AdID data collection via their official opt-out flags.

Replaces the IMSI lookup with the public getSimOperator() call so the pre-login flow passes on Android 11+ where re-signed builds lost carrier privileges ('App Error: NO IMSI'). Falls back to Dialog's 41305 on SIM-less devices.
